power.capacity-scope: the load the PDU can hand on, 3.7 kW (the "Output kW" column of the maker's table). It is not what the PDU draws itself, which the basic version does not state

configs.description: The PDU as it ships: the fixed cord and the two push-button attachments on it. The universal mounting kit, the connector lock and the mounting adaptor are not drawn.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: the data sheet (dri1308088en, p.1) says black anodised RAL 9005 ("other colours may be configured") and black is drawn; the photographs of the basic family show a natural silver extrusion, none of this SKU, so whether a unit of this SKU ships in another finish is not known. The screen value #0e0e10 is the usual one for RAL 9005, estimated.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of this SKU, or a rating plate or order note naming its finish.

gaps.note: the circuit diagram numbers the outlets 1 to 13, and no photograph of this SKU shows what is printed beside them; no name is taken, so the placement ids stand.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the printed outlet numbers.

gaps.note: the three outlet cells are drawn as full-width plates in the colour of the L1 plate of the DK 7979.130 render (the data sheet: L1 pink; this unit's circuit diagram labels its one line L1); no photograph of this SKU is held, so whether a single-phase unit's plates are that colour is not known. The blank cells and the head cap are drawn in that model's end-cap colour, and the narrow margin each plate may leave at its edges is not measured.
gaps.wanted: a straight-on photograph of the front with a scale.

gaps.note: the mounting adaptor 7000.688 and the universal mounting kit are named and not drawn; the attachment on the enclosure frame at the side of the 19" frame is named and not dimensioned.
the end view draws the strip's section with the gland and the button and no detail; no photograph looks at an end or a side straight on.
gaps.wanted: straight-on photographs of an end and a side.
one of `power-max-w`, `power-max-ac-w`, `power-max-dc-w` in `attrs.power` (profile `power` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

breakers.note: datasheet - dri1308088en p.1: "No. of circuit-breakers 2 (single-phase) or 6 (3-phase) with 32 A version"; the table prints this SKU at 16 A and the sheet's feature table has the breaker "only for 32 A PDU versions", so a 16 A version has none. The circuit diagram draws none. No breaker is drawn and none is stated.

chassis.note: drawing - length 695 (the table of page 1 prints 695 as well), width 44 (the data sheet's "44 mm (1 U)"), depth 72.1 (the side view's dimension). The data sheet (dri1308088en, p.1) prints "PDU enclosure depth 70 mm" and the end view 109; the 109 is the body with the cable gland standing out of the front and the button out of the back, and the 70 is the extrusion profile, as the DK 7979.130 model reads the same figures. 72.1 is drawn.

colour.note: The data sheet (dri1308088en, p.1) says "Aluminium, anodised in RAL 9005 (black, other colours may be configured)", so the body is drawn black. The RAL class is the sheet's; the screen value (#0e0e10) is the usual one for RAL 9005 and is estimated, not measured. The photographs held of the basic family show a natural silver side, and none is of this SKU: a unit configured in another finish would differ, and the gap below says so.

dcim.note: the input is one power port from the cord part and each outlet a power outlet it feeds. C13 and C19 export as the IEC types; the CEE plug exports as `other` with a label, because no upstream type for it has been read from a held source.

front.note: drawing - the front view of page 3, mm from the foot end: the foot cell 0 to 72.1 with the gland; two blank cells to 116.3 and to 160.5; a block of six C13 cells to 341.1 and a second to 521.6; a C19 cell to 567.4; two blank cells to 611.7 and to 656.2; and the head cap, 656.2 to 695, with its ribs. Each C13 stands in its housing as the DK 7979.142 model places it (earth slot toward the head); the C19 as the DK 7979.130 places it (long axis along the strip). Outlets count from the foot.

input.note: datasheet - dri1308088en p.1: "Input voltage range (L - N) 230 V (400 V, 3~), 50 - 60 Hz", "Input current 16 A/32 A (depending on product variant)", "No. of wires 3/5", "Connection cable type H05-VV", "Length of connection cable 3m"; the table: 1~, 16 A, 3.7 kW, input CEE; the circuit diagram draws the plug "CEE 16 A/1P" with the wires L, PE and N and labels the line L1. A single-phase input states no wiring (`input-phase: single`). The unit has a fixed cord and no inlet. `plug-rating-a` is not written: the data sheet rates the unit, not the plug.

lifecycle.note: the maker's page lists the SKU among the 27 basic variants; no end-of-life notice was found in the pages read.

logo.note: no photograph of this SKU is held; the RITTAL mark of the basic family's renders is not drawn.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S DIMENSIONED DRAWING. Rittal, "Technical details, Power Distribution Unit, Basic version" (dri2108028en, 08.2023), PDF page 3, DK 7979.110: a plan view (the back), a side view, an end view and a front view, with the circuit diagram below. The cell lines of the front view were read from a 600 dpi render of that page at the drawing's own scale: the 695 overall length between the two ends of the front view reads 1351 px (1.944 px per mm), the same scale the DK 7979.130 page gives. Each cell edge is a full-height line of the front view. Good to about 0.5 mm. The outlet housings were read the same way: the C13 housings repeat every 28.3 mm (five pitches, read to 0.1 mm); a block of six stands 8.2 mm from the foot edge of its cell and about 2.7 mm from the head edge. An outlet stands at the centre of its housing.

mount.note: `rack-side`, the library's way to say a part stands vertically beside an upright, on the two push-button attachments of the plan view (dimensioned 622.3 apart). The data sheet's "PDU mounting options" are the enclosure frame at the side of the 482.6 mm mounting frame (zero-U space) and the cable route (push-button attachment); the mounting adaptor 7000.688 is an accessory and is not drawn. `ru: 16` is the 695 mm it runs, 695 / 44.45 = 15.6; the data sheet sells it by minimum rack height (1200 for a VX IT frame) and not by rack units.

mounting-buttons.note: drawing - the plan view of page 3: two buttons 622.3 apart (dimensioned); the 695 mm strip is the DK 7979.130's length, and the buttons are placed as that model places them (36.1 and 36.6 in from the two ends, plate 25.2 along the strip). The foot end of the plan view is taken to be the end of the front view's foot cell; the two positions are equal to within 0.5 mm.

outlets.note: datasheet and drawing - the table of page 1 ("PDU basic"): DK 7979.110, 1~, 16 A, 3.7 kW, CEE input, 12 IEC C13, 1 IEC C19, no earthing-pin, 695 mm; the circuit diagram draws the outlets in blocks "6 x C13", "6 x C13" and "1 x C19" and numbers them 1 to 13. std/c13-outlet@1 and std/c19-outlet@1. None is switched; none has a lamp. NO OUTLET NAME IS WRITTEN: no held photograph is of this SKU, so what the unit prints beside an outlet is not known, and the outlets keep their placement ids, counted from the foot.

rear.note: drawing - the plan view draws the same two long grooves, ridge and two buttons as the DK 7979.130 model reads, from 2.6 in of each end.
